Data: `data/water_municipal.csv` (one row = municipality x zone x year, 2010-2023).
IRCA here is **utility-supplied ("prestadores") IRCA** from INS open data, not INS's national total.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("data/water_municipal.csv", dtype={"divipola": str})
print(f"{df.shape[0]:,} rows x {df.shape[1]} columns")
df.dtypes.to_frame("dtype").T
```

## Missing values (%) per column, by zone

```{python}
miss = df.drop(columns="zone").isna().groupby(df["zone"]).mean().mul(100).round(1).T
miss
```

## IRCA bands (Resolución 2115 de 2007, art. 15), by zone

Counts of rows with a utility-supplied IRCA value.

```{python}
bins = [-0.001, 5, 14, 35, 80, 100]
labels = ["no risk (0-5)", "low (5.1-14)", "medium (14.1-35)", "high (35.1-80)", "inviable (80.1-100)"]
d = df.dropna(subset=["irca"]).copy()
d["band"] = pd.cut(d["irca"], bins=bins, labels=labels)
pd.crosstab(d["band"], d["zone"], margins=True)
```

## Median IRCA (utility-supplied) by year and zone

```{python}
med = df.pivot_table(index="year", columns="zone", values="irca", aggfunc="median").round(1)
med
```

```{python}
ax = med.plot(marker="o", title="Median IRCA (utility-supplied, INS open data) by year and zone")
ax.set_ylabel("median IRCA (0-100)")
```
